description:
No spec subject (candidates: specled.verification docs surface when picked up). Severity: Medium. From 2026-08-06 critical review of specled_-q0q. spec.check --run-commands executes verification commands defined in repo-resident spec files; in a CI configured to run on fork PRs this executes attacker-authored shell with the workflow token. Keep-reason: docs/policy deliverable (threat-model statement + recommended CI gating for public repos), not a code fix on the shipped branch. Concrete failure: a public repo running armed spec.check on pull_request from forks grants fork authors arbitrary command execution in CI.

## ORCHESTRATOR CONTRACT (specled_-i4x)

Advances: specled.package

(Orchestrator note: NOT specled.verification — that subject owns command execution
mechanics; this ticket ships no code. Model the new requirement on the existing
specled.package.adoption_guide / .concepts_guide pattern, .spec/specs/package.spec.md:104-111.)

Allowed touches:
- docs/security.md (new)
- docs/adoption.md  — the "CI should always run commands" line at docs/adoption.md:489
  must be CORRECTED, not merely supplemented. It is the unsafe advice.
- README.md
- .spec/specs/package.spec.md  (new requirement + surface: entry for docs/security.md)
- .spec/decisions/specled.decision.*.md  (only if the policy is a durable cross-cutting stance)
- CHANGELOG.md

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/** (all)
- test/** except test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs
- .spec/realization_hashes.json
- priv/spec_init/workflows/spec_review.yml.eex  (also specled.spec_review surface; widens the ticket)

Out of Scope (intent):
- Do NOT flip the --run-commands default or add a sandbox/allowlist. This deliverable is a
  written policy. Changing the default is a separate breaking change against
  .spec/specs/mix_tasks.spec.md.
- Do NOT name any finding code the implementation does not emit. docs/**/*.md is inside the
  doc-identifier lint corpus (test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs:223) and an invented code
  name fails the gate. Show severities in bare YAML token form, not atom form
  (specled.package.doc_identifier_integrity, .spec/specs/package.spec.md:112).
- Do NOT write a generic SECURITY.md disclosure process. The ask is one threat statement
  plus the CI recommendation.

Verification:
  mix test test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs
  mix test test/specled_ex/verifier_test.exs
  mix compile --warnings-as-errors
  mix format --check-formatted
  mix spec.check --no-run-commands
  bash ./scripts/check_specs.sh
No execute:false stub to flip. The doc-identifier lint is the real gate: it pins corpus size
and fails on any invented code name.

Expected diff: ~130-200 lines across 4-6 files, mostly the new doc.
title: F12: --run-commands executes repo-resident shell — document fork-PR CI trust policy
